decisive_finding.reproduction: A consumed receipt_id was reused with a distinct unused approval after changing the receipt nonce session source and row bindings; a fresh mediator accepted the revived receipt.
decisive_finding.cause: Receipt consumption keys included mutable row and session digests and lacked an immutable repository-scoped receipt_id tombstone.

required_correction: tombstone consumed receipt_id and approval_id under their exact protected namespace and repository
make tombstones independent of mutable row source session nonce candidate context and digest fields
retain detailed bound keys as supplemental exact-set evidence rather than replay identity
reject isolated receipt and approval revival while preserving distinct stable IDs and cross-repository separation
prove concurrent one-winner and failed-final no-consumption behavior
root_disposition: The proposal remains non-authoritative. Stable tombstones are only an in-process model; durable cross-process replay authority remains withheld.
no_claim_statement: This REWORK decision authorizes no external effect and changes no adopted contract, product behavior, claim ceiling, readiness, release, node closure, or goal-completion state.
